dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (DSM, ~30m) - Mumbai + buffer tiles
source: European Space Agency / Copernicus, hosted by OpenTopography (post-Jul-2024: direct ESA PRISM mirror; also historically via AWS Open Data / Sinergise S3 bucket)
source_url_bulk_aws: s3://raster/COP30/ (endpoint https://opentopography.s3.sdsc.edu, --no-sign-request, no auth needed for AWS CLI bulk listing/copy)
license: Copernicus DEM license: © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the EU and ESA. Free for general public use; attribution required. Full terms: https://spacedata.copernicus.eu/documents/20126/0/CSCDA_ESA_Mission-specific+Annex.pdf
download_date: NOT DOWNLOADED (requires network access this chat session does not have; see scripts/download_dem.sh)
temporal_resolution: static (2010-2015 TanDEM-X acquisition epoch, DGED 2023_1 release)
coverage: Mumbai bbox approx 72.75-72.98E, 18.85-19.30N (see 01_city/config.json) - the API call above subsets exactly this
file_size: unknown until downloaded; a ~0.23deg x 0.45deg tile at 30m is roughly 5-15 MB as GeoTIFF
limitations: This is a DSM (includes buildings/vegetation), not a bare-earth DTM. No hydro-conditioning applied. Requires a free OpenTopography account for the API-key route (instant approval, no cost) OR unauthenticated AWS S3 bulk access.
processing: NONE PERFORMED - raw DEM only, as instructed. Do not derive slope/flow-direction/flow-accumulation here; that belongs to the downstream pipeline.
notes: SECONDARY (CartoDEM / India-specific DEM): No legitimate open/free public download of CartoDEM (Bhuvan/NRSC product) for Mumbai was found without an active, approved Bhuvan account with project-specific access. Bhuvan (https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in) offers a free account and a DEM download tool (Bhuvan Data Download), but its terms and the exact tile boundaries require interactive account-based access this session cannot complete. Documented as NOT VERIFIED / requires manual retrieval via a free Bhuvan account.
